lines.text: Do you know why people are using Orbi Transfer?
Let's open Orbi Work. One clean board for your whole team, right in the browser. No accounts.
First, make a private space. Give it a name, add a passcode, and only your team gets in.
Now add a task. Give it a name, like Richard's task. Write what needs doing, and tag him.
Hit submit, and upload the files straight into it.
Double-click the task to set its route. In progress, in review, delivered. Need something else? Make a custom step.
And every step wears the colour you pick. Purple for review, green for done. Your call.
Click a step, and your whole team sees it change, live.
Too messy? Hit arrange. Every file lines up with its task. Wires dead straight.
Client changed their mind? Cancel it, and it turns red.
Every file is encrypted in your browser before it leaves, and it burns on time.
Orbi Transfer dot com, slash work. Try it with your team.
